feature_strategy: V1 Order/Product Basic: baseline using simple order, customer profile, product, price, promotion, payment, and channel features.
V2 Customer Behavior Focus: focuses on customer history, return ratio, rolling behavior, spend, COD, and high-discount behavior.
V3 Product & Category Risk Focus: focuses on product/category/brand/supplier risk, quality, rating, damage, and price-index features.
V4 Logistics & Payment Risk Focus: focuses on courier, logistics, payment, channel, province, COD, and remote-area risk.
V5 Hybrid Compact Best: compact hybrid selected from customer, product, logistics, payment, and interaction features.
